payload.display_name: Reutter, Semisimple 4-dimensional topological field theories cannot detect exotic smooth structure
payload.scope_note: Reference subject for Proposition 3.2, Theorem 3.5, and Example 3.6: ordinary semisimple 4-dimensional TQFT connected-sum behavior and invertibility of the S2xS2 value. These results support the ordinary CYK stabilization discussion but do not by themselves establish the marked connected-sum formula or normalization bridge for Yetter's homologically twisted background theory.
